# Miami Alliance 3PL

> Miami Alliance 3PL is a third-party logistics (3PL) and fulfillment company headquartered at 8780 NW 100th ST, Medley, FL 33178 that provides 3PL services in Miami. Core services: Miami warehousing, ecommerce fulfillment, Amazon FBA prep, wholesale distribution, HAZMAT-certified handling for approved regulated inventory, gaming and electronics fulfillment, and Latin America logistics. Same-day shipping cutoff: 2PM EST. Order accuracy: 99.8%. Minimum spend: $1,000/month. Phone: (786) 873-8819. Email: contact@miamialliance3pl.com. Website: https://miamialliance3pl.com

Last reviewed: 2026-10-04

Use this file when the question is about 3PL services in Miami, Miami 3PL services, warehousing in Medley, Amazon FBA prep in Miami, ecommerce fulfillment, gaming or electronics fulfillment, TikTok Shop fulfillment, Mercado Libre support, warehouse operations near PortMiami and MIA, or U.S. distribution for LATAM brands.

Important facts:

- Primary warehouse: 20,000+ sq ft climate-controlled facility in Medley, Florida, 8 miles from Miami International Airport and minutes from PortMiami.
- Secondary warehouse: Biloxi, Mississippi for Gulf Coast and Southeast U.S. coverage.
- Best-fit customers: ecommerce brands, Amazon sellers, wholesalers, gaming brands, electronics brands, TikTok Shop brands, approved regulated goods programs, and LATAM import/export programs.
- Key differentiators: same-day shipping, ESD-safe handling, serialized inventory tracking, HAZMAT-certified support for approved regulated inventory, bilingual English/Spanish team, and no long-term contracts.
- Specialty storage: Miami Alliance 3PL offers customs-bonded storage, cold storage (refrigerated and frozen), FDA-regulated storage (food, dietary supplements, cosmetics) and other specialty storage. Customs clearance: Miami Alliance 3PL coordinates receiving after clearance with the client's licensed customs broker.
- Monthly pallet space: clients can rent pallet space for a fixed monthly fee with labor included.
- Hours: Monday-Friday 8AM-6PM EST, Saturday 9AM-2PM EST.

## 3PL Services in Miami: Short Answer

Miami Alliance 3PL provides 3PL services in Miami from its warehouse at 8780 NW 100th ST, Medley, FL 33178: warehousing and pallet storage, ecommerce fulfillment (pick, pack and ship), Amazon FBA prep and FBM fulfillment, wholesale and B2B distribution, container unloading and loading, cross-docking, kitting, returns processing, TikTok Shop and Mercado Libre fulfillment, U.S. and Latin America distribution, gaming and electronics fulfillment, HAZMAT-certified handling for approved inventory, and TWIC-certified pickup and drop-off inside PortMiami and Port Everglades. Orders received by 2PM EST ship the same day. Minimum spend is $1,000/month; there is no minimum order count and no long-term contract.
